opening.argument: The offer is presented as an ordinary survey-based promotion tied to a Best Buy gift card. The narrator says viewers can receive a $250 Best Buy gift card and directs them to answer quick questions, enter a valid email address, acknowledge the terms, and continue. The visible survey page reinforces that process with the gift-card offer, question buttons, email prompt, acknowledgment checkbox, and Continue button. These promotional and lead-capture steps, standing alone, do not establish that the reward will fail to arrive, that the affiliation is unauthorized, that payment is collected, that credentials are stolen, or that any harmful outcome has occurred.
